title: Scanned OCR to Markdown input
description: Add scanned PDF or image files by URL or upload. Output Markdown and/or RAG chunks. Uses RapidOCR (onnxruntime) — works offline in the Actor container after build.

urls.title: Document URLs (PDF or image)
urls.description: Direct links to scanned PDFs or images (png/jpg/webp/tiff). Prefer direct download links.

files.title: Upload files
files.description: Upload scanned PDFs or images (stored in your Apify key-value store).

outputFormat.title: Output
outputFormat.description: `markdown`: one dataset item per document. `chunks`: RAG-ready chunks. `markdown_and_chunks`: both.

pageMarkers.title: Page markers
pageMarkers.description: How page boundaries appear in Markdown.

saveMarkdownFiles.title: Also save .md files
saveMarkdownFiles.description: Save each document as a .md file in the run's key-value store.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size
chunkSize.description: Maximum chunk size (unit below). Same field names as the digital PDF/DOCX Actor.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap
chunkOverlap.description: How much trailing context from the previous chunk is repeated (same unit as chunk size, max 50% of chunk size).

chunkUnit.title: Chunk size unit
chunkUnit.description: `tokens` uses ≈4 characters per token; `characters` is exact.

prependHeadingPath.title: Prefix chunks with their section path
prependHeadingPath.description: Adds a `Section: …` line to each chunk's text when headings were detected.

maxPagesPerDocument.title: Max pages per document
maxPagesPerDocument.description: Safety cap on pages OCR'd (and billed) per PDF. 0 = no cap.

dpi.title: Render DPI (PDF)
dpi.description: Rasterization DPI before OCR. Higher = slower/more RAM, often better on small text. Range 72–400.

repairTables.title: Assemble tables from OCR boxes
repairTables.description: Cluster wide-gap OCR lines into Markdown tables. Best-effort geometry; not the digital-PDF word-index repair.
